refactor: remove IMessage namespace, use direct type exports for better IDE support

BREAKING CHANGE: Remove IMessage namespace. Users should now import types directly:
- Before: import type { IMessage } from '@photon-ai/imessage-kit'; type Msg = IMessage.Message
- After: import type { Message } from '@photon-ai/imessage-kit'; type Msg = Message

This fixes type resolution issues where Message type appeared as 'any' in some IDEs.

refactor: improve watcher callback naming for clarity

BREAKING CHANGE: Watcher API redesign

- Remove onNewMessage (was confusing, only handled DMs)
- Add onMessage for all messages (DMs + groups)
- Add onDirectMessage for DMs only
- Keep onGroupMessage for groups only

Benefits:
- Clear, consistent naming
- Flexible message filtering
- No complex configuration needed
- Intuitive callback names

Migration:
- Replace onNewMessage with onDirectMessage
- Use onMessage to handle all message types

fix 🐛: force iMessage service on buddy-based sends to prevent SMS fallback

When sending to a recipient by phone number or email, the AppleScript
used a bare `buddy "recipient"` lookup with no service specified. On
machines where both iMessage and SMS relay are active, Messages resolves
the buddy against whichever service is default — often SMS — resulting
in green bubble messages even when the recipient supports iMessage.

Fix all four buddy-based send helpers to explicitly resolve the buddy
against the iMessage service:

  set targetService to 1st service whose service type = iMessage
  set targetBuddy to buddy "<recipient>" of targetService

Affected functions:
- generateSendTextScript
- generateSendWithAttachmentScript
- generateSandboxBypassScript (file attachment helper)
- generateDirectSendScript (file attachment helper)

Chat ID-based sends (generateSendTextToChat etc.) are unaffected as they
use `chat id "..."` which already resolves the correct service.

Fixes #39
